tests: an edit at the error panel prints Aborting, and then the rest of Main runs
steps:
1. A Sub Main that calls Fails, then prints main end; Fails raises an error with Err.Raise and then prints after raise.
2. Press F5. The run stops at the error panel on the Err.Raise line.
3. Type a letter anywhere in the code editor. The DEBUG CONSOLE prints [EDIT & CONTINUE] not yet supported.  Aborting., then main end: the rest of Fails is skipped, and the rest of Main runs.
Control: the same edit at a breakpoint prints Aborting. and aborted, and nothing more of the program runs.
